# AI Chauffeur

> Answers the call. Quotes your rates. Books the trip.

AI Chauffeur answers the phone for limousine and black car companies. Answers the call. Quotes your rates. Books the trip. The trip sheet lands in your CRM, your texts and your inbox.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-18

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://aichauffeur.ai/pricing/): One price. Everything on the list.
- AI Chauffeur is $997 a month plus a $997 one-time setup. Connected and custom work is priced after the setup call.

## What it does

- It takes the whole trip like your best dispatcher — flight number, meet and greet, passengers, bags, child seats, gate codes.
- Picks the right car for the group. If there are more people than the car holds, it moves the trip up to a bigger car.
- Trip sheet on your phone. Text to you, text to the customer, the recording and every word of the call attached.
- Every call recorded. The recording and every word of the call come back with the trip sheet.
- Your people run the cars. AI Chauffeur runs the phones.
- [What it does](https://aichauffeur.ai/what-it-does/): Every part of a call, from the answer to the trip sheet
- [What it can do for your company](https://aichauffeur.ai/what-it-can-do/): Every company runs its phones a little differently. These are set up for your company when we build your desk.

## Book the setup call

- [Book the setup call](https://aichauffeur.ai/book/): Schedules the 20-minute setup call.
- Setup builds it for your company: your company name, your service area, your fleet, your rate sheet and who gets the trip sheets.
- The setup call is a conversation, not a pitch.
- Setup is done for you by our team. Typical timeline is one to two weeks once your rate rules, service area, and dispatch process are documented.
- [How setup works](https://aichauffeur.ai/how-setup-works/): How setup works, step by step, is written out in full.

## FAQ

- Does it replace my dispatcher? No. It takes the phones so your dispatcher is not buried by missed calls and repeated questions.
- What still requires dispatcher approval? Assigning the car and the driver.
- AI Chauffeur is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

## Answers

- [Can it pick the right vehicle for the number of bags?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/can-it-pick-the-right-vehicle-for-the-number-of-bags/): Yes. AI Chauffeur picks the vehicle from your own fleet list that fits the passengers and the bags. If nothing fits, it flags the trip for dispatch.
- [Does it answer the phone at 3 AM?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/does-it-answer-the-phone-at-3-am/): Yes. AI Chauffeur answers every call in your company name, quotes from your rate sheet and books the trip, at 3 AM the same as at 3 PM.
- [Does it quote prices?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/does-it-quote-prices/): Yes. Set up for your company, AI Chauffeur quotes from your own rate sheet. A price that is not on the sheet is flagged for dispatch, never made up.
- [Does it work with my booking software?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/does-it-work-with-my-booking-software/): Yes. It connects to CRMs too, and we check your reservation software and handle the connection. Your team keeps the software it already runs.
- [Does the caller know they're talking to a computer?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/does-the-caller-know-theyre-talking-to-a-computer/): The name says what it is. AI Chauffeur answers in your company name, books the trip, and hands the call to your team when a caller asks for a person.
- [How fast is a booking call?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/how-fast-is-a-booking-call/): As fast as the caller. AI Chauffeur keeps what the caller says first, asks only for what is missing, quotes from your rate sheet and books the trip.
- [What does dispatch actually get after a call?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/what-does-dispatch-actually-get-after-a-call/): The trip sheet, in your CRM, your texts and your inbox, with the recording and the transcript. Calls on booked trips come to dispatch by text.
- [What happens if it doesn't understand a name or an address?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/what-happens-if-it-doesnt-understand-a-name-or-an-address/): It asks once more. If the name or address is still unclear, AI Chauffeur flags it for dispatch instead of guessing, and the recording comes along.
- [What happens when a caller wants to change or cancel a trip?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/what-happens-when-a-caller-wants-to-change-or-cancel-a-trip/): AI Chauffeur takes the message and texts dispatch right away. It never changes or cancels a trip itself. Your team makes the change.
- [What if the caller has a question it can't answer?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/what-if-the-caller-has-a-question-it-cant-answer/): It does not guess. AI Chauffeur hands the call to your team, and a price that is not on your rate sheet is flagged for dispatch, never made up.
- [Can it handle airport pickups with flight numbers?](https://aichauffeur.ai/answers/can-it-handle-airport-pickups-with-flight-numbers/): Yes. AI Chauffeur takes the whole airport pickup, flight number included, and the flight number goes on the trip sheet for dispatch.
